name: New Testament
overview: The New Testament reveals God's profound love for the world by giving His only begotten Son so that believers may have eternal life, as declared in John 3:16. It also calls Christians to live transformed lives, rejecting sin despite the abundance of grace (Romans 6:1) and walking in the Spirit to overcome fleshly desires (Galatians 5:16). Additionally, the New Testament affirms the divine origin of its revelation through Jesus Christ, emphasizing the authority and certainty of its message (Revelation 1:1).
